verdict.rationale: The evidence documents no platform API for generating or managing Figma Make apps programmatically. All documented features are interactive: chats, attachments, code editing and version history. A community report says Figma's API returns 400 for .make files, forcing users to reverse-engineer the format. Probes found no OpenAPI spec. MCP connectivity is client-side context ingestion and does not count toward this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can generate and manage apps programmatically through a platform API
